summary: A paper from IBM researchers on describing data so it can be shared across a network. They sort differences in how data is represented into three levels, starting with the very local, like character sets and number formats, and argue a data description language could help bridge them.

eli5.summary: Different computers write down the same information in different ways. This paper suggests a common way to describe data so one computer can understand another's.

questions: data description language for shared data
